I don't know for certain. I'm not aware of a promptfoo filter called "range" with documented start and end indices, and I can't check the docs or source from here. The working directory doesn't contain promptfoo code I can read.

The CLI filters I believe exist are `--filter-first-n`, `--filter-pattern`, `--filter-sample`, `--filter-failing`, and `--filter-errors-only`. If you're using a range option, check the version you have with `promptfoo eval --help`, or look at the docs or source for that option.

If the implementation uses JavaScript's `slice(start, end)`, the end index is exclusive, so `end` would not be run. That's an assumption about the implementation, not something I've verified. A quick test with a small dataset will confirm the behavior.
